summary_en: 200,000 shares (2.4% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired over ¥500M limit. Acquisition window 10 Aug 2026 to 30 Apr 2027. Method: open-market purchases and ToSTNeT-3. Authorized under Articles of Incorporation and Companies Act Article 165(2).
title_en: Notice on Setting Authorization Framework for Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, the board of Okada Aiyon Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 200,000 ordinary shares (2.4% of shares outstanding, calculated as 200,000 ÷ 8,057,340 ex-treasury shares) within a ceiling of ¥500 million. The acquisition window runs from 10 August 2026 to 30 April 2027. Shares may be acquired via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement, or via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange trading). The authorization was granted under Article 165(2) of the Companies Act and Article 33 of the company's articles of incorporation. The company stated that the framework is intended to secure flexibility in future capital allocation decisions while pursuing its medium-term business plan 'Onyx' (formulated May 2026) and balancing improved capital efficiency with enhanced shareholder returns.
